if.test: (status == null or status == '') and includeClosed != true

where.if: AND CASE WHEN #{timePeriod} = '上午' THEN HOUR(TIME(STR_TO_DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(cg.class_time_desc, cg.schedule_text), '[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}'), '%H:%i'))) < 12 WHEN #{timePeriod} = '下午' THEN HOUR(TIME(STR_TO_DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(cg.class_time_desc, cg.schedule_text), '[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}'), '%H:%i'))) >= 12 AND HOUR(TIME(STR_TO_DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(cg.class_time_desc, cg.schedule_text), '[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}'), '%H:%i'))) < 18 WHEN #{timePeriod} = '晚上' THEN HOUR(TIME(STR_TO_DATE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(cg.class_time_desc, cg.schedule_text), '[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}'), '%H:%i'))) >= 18 ELSE TRUE END

mapper.sql: cg.id, cg.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, cg.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.category AS courseCategory, cg.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(t.name, cg.teacher_text) AS teacherName, cg.assist_name AS assistName, cg.name, cg.lesson_class_name AS lessonClassName, cg.room, cg.schedule_text AS scheduleText, cg.start_date AS startDate, cg.end_date AS endDate, cg.status, cg.capacity, cg.enrolled_count AS enrolledCount, cg.stu_rate AS stuRate, cg.up_rate AS upRate, cg.schedule_count AS scheduleCount, cg.enrolling, cg.create_by AS createBy, cg.created_at AS createdAt, cg.fee_standard AS feeStandard, cg.source, cg.sp_class_id AS spClassId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = cg.id) AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule s WHERE s.class_id = cg.id) AS lessonCount, (SELECT MAX(s2.lesson_date) FROM schedule s2 WHERE s2.class_id = cg.id) AS lastLessonDate
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM class_group cg JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = cg.campus_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cg.teacher_id WHERE cg.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(cg.status = '已开班'), 0) AS active FROM class_group cg LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cg.teacher_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.student_id) AS studentCount, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM class_student cs JOIN student st ON st.id = cs.student_id AND st.status = '在读' JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = cs.class_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cg.teacher_id

SELECT cs.id, cs.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, st.phone, st.primary_relation AS relation, st.follow_status AS followStatus, st.gender, cs.status, cs.join_date AS joinDate, cs.total_lessons AS totalLessons, cs.used_lessons AS usedLessons, cs.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.debt, cs.remark FROM class_student cs JOIN student st ON st.id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY cs.status = '在读' DESC, st.name

SELECT s.id, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), c.name) AS courseName, s.room, s.topic, s.status, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.assistant_name AS assistantName, s.should_count AS shouldCount, s.actual_count AS actualCount, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS attendanceCount, COALESCE(a.present_cnt, 0) AS presentCount, COALESCE(a.leave_cnt, 0) AS leaveCount, COALESCE(a.absent_cnt, 0) AS absentCount, COALESCE(a.late_cnt, 0) AS lateCount, COALESCE(a.lesson_sum, 0) AS lessonCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(a.present_cnt * 100 / a.cnt, 2) END AS attendanceRate, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS commentCount, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(status = '出勤') AS present_cnt, SUM(status = '请假') AS leave_cnt, SUM(status IN ('缺席', '旷课')) AS absent_cnt, SUM(status = '迟到') AS late_cnt, SUM(lessons) AS lesson_sum FROM attendance GROUP BY schedule_id ) a ON a.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM class_comment GROUP BY schedule_id) cc ON cc.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.status = '已上课' ORDER BY s.lesson_date DESC, s.start_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.schedule_id AS scheduleId, a.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, a.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.topic, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, a.status, a.lessons, a.remark FROM attendance a JOIN student st ON st.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = a.teacher_id WHERE a.class_id = #{classId} AND a.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY a.lesson_date DESC, a.id, st.name

SELECT cc.id, cc.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) AS teacherName, COALESCE(s.lesson_date, DATE(cc.created_at)) AS lessonDate, cc.content, cc.rating, cc.read_at AS readAt, cc.created_at AS createdAt FROM class_comment cc JOIN student st ON st.id = cc.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id WHERE cc.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY lessonDate DESC, cc.id DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(a.status = '出勤') * 100 / COUNT(*), 2) END FROM attendance a WHERE a.class_id = #{classId} AND a.status <> '未记录'
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(t.name, cg.teacher_text) AS name FROM class_group cg LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cg.teacher_id ) x WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' ORDER BY name
SELECT DISTINCT lesson_class_name FROM class_group WHERE lesson_class_name IS NOT NULL AND lesson_class_name <> '' ORDER BY lesson_class_name
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM class_group cg JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id WHERE c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name <> '' ORDER BY c.name
SELECT DISTINCT c.category FROM class_group cg JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id WHERE c.category IS NOT NULL AND c.category <> '' ORDER BY c.category
SELECT DISTINCT room FROM class_group WHERE room IS NOT NULL AND room <> '' ORDER BY room

SELECT cg.id, cg.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, cg.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, cg.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(t.name, cg.teacher_text) AS teacherName, cg.name, cg.room, cg.schedule_text AS scheduleText, cg.start_date AS startDate, cg.end_date AS endDate, cg.status, cg.capacity, cg.enrolled_count AS enrolledCount FROM class_group cg LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = cg.campus_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cg.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cg.teacher_id WHERE cg.course_id = #{courseId} AND cg.status <> '已结班' ORDER BY cg.start_date DESC, cg.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, s.phone, COALESCE(cur.class_id, e.class_id) AS classId, COALESCE(cur.class_name, cg.name) AS className, e.total_lessons AS totalLessons, e.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, e.status AS enrollStatus FROM enrollment e JOIN student s ON s.id = e.student_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = e.class_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cg2.id AS class_id, cg2.name AS class_name FROM class_student cs JOIN class_group cg2 ON cg2.id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = s.id AND cg2.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY (cs.status = '在读') DESC, cs.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) cur ON TRUE WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.status = '生效' AND e.id = ( SELECT MAX(e2.id) FROM enrollment e2 WHERE e2.student_id = e.student_id AND e2.course_id = e.course_id AND e2.status = '生效' ) ORDER BY (COALESCE(cur.class_id, e.class_id) IS NULL) DESC, s.name
